The Leap Scholarship 2022 is an opportunity offered by the LeapScholar (a non-profit organization helping students to study abroad) to master's/PGD level course applicants. It is an initiative to encourage and support students who want to pursue higher education abroad. The scholarship provides an opportunity to Indian students to grow both personally and professionally and accelerate their careers in a global environment. The selected candidates will receive up to 100% tuition fee.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Have a minimum IELTS score of 6 (with 5.5 in each band)
Have scored more than 60% in 12th standard exams
Have scored more than 60% (or its equivalent) in undergraduate study
Be a fresher or have 0-4 years of work experience
Have an admit from a designated learning institute in the UK, US, Canada, Australia or Ireland
Have an admit from a full-time program more than 8-month duration
Have not received any other scholarship/ grant/bursary for the program for which Leap Scholarship is sought
The selected candidates will receive up to 100% tuition fee.

In 500 words or less, what are the career goals/aspirations?
In 300 words or less, how will an education abroad help in achieving goals?
In 300 words or less, what additional qualities/skills do the applicant have that make the applicant an ideal candidate for this scholarship?
